episodes.title: 3AM
episodes.summary: After he apparently dies, Frank tries to live peacefully but events overtake him. Meanwhile, an ICE agent tries to track down a U.S. military heroin ring.

episodes.title: Two Dead Men
episodes.summary: The elusive whistleblower known as Micro contacts Frank, who tracks Micro back to the family that believes he's dead. Meanwhile, Karen does some research for Frank, and Dinah goes on a date with Billy Russo.

episodes.title: Kandahar
episodes.summary: While Frank questions Micro about his intentions, he remembers what happened in Kandahar as part of Operation Cerberus.

episodes.title: Resupply
episodes.summary: Frank goes after arms dealers, and discovers that Dinah and her team are after them as well. Meanwhile, Sarah gets a return visit from Frank, and Dinah gets a visit from her mentor.

episodes.title: Gunner
episodes.summary: Frank and Micro track down Gunner, and Frank goes to see his old friend and learn if he knows who Agent Orange is. Meanwhile, Dinah lies under oath to cover up Frank's involvement,and Karen reaches out to Frank after Dinah interviews her.

episodes.title: The Judas Goat
episodes.summary: After Frank is injured, Micro turns to Curtis for help. Meanwhile, Dinah asks Billy if he knows that Frank is alive, and Lewis learns where O'Connor served.

episodes.title: Crosshairs
episodes.summary: Clay tries to give his son Lewis some advice. Meanwhile, Frank attacks Bennett but it's a ruse to get Bennett to lead them to Agent Orange.

episodes.title: Cold Steel
episodes.summary: After paying his mother a visit, Billy tells Dinah about his childhood. Meanwhile, Dinah sets a trap for the person who has bugged her office, while Micro and Frank discuss strategy.

episodes.title: Front Toward Enemy
episodes.summary: Lewis declares war on the government and anyone who supports it, and sends his manifesto to Karen. Meanwhile, Dinah considers what to say at Sam's service, or whether she should say anything at all.

episodes.title: Virtue of the Vicious
episodes.summary: Lewis goes after Ori and Frank tries to stop him. Afterward, Detective Sergeant Mahoney tries to piece together what happened. Meanwhile, Dinah tells Hernandez what really happened that got Sam and the others killed.

episodes.title: Danger Close
episodes.summary: Billy captures Sarah and Zach, and sends a squad of mercenaries to the power station. Frank is waiting. Meanwhile, Dinah meets with Billy and then Marion.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.summary: Frank gives Dinah what she wants, and she learns that he murdered her former partner. Meanwhile, Micro and Frank make a deal to get Sarah and Zach back, but one of them is killed in the process.

episodes.title: Memento Mori
episodes.summary: Billy escapes capture and takes hostages to force Frank to come to him for a final showdown.

episodes.title: Roadhouse Blues
episodes.summary: Frank stops at a roadhouse and makes a new friend, and soon gets involved in trouble when thugs come after a young girl who may or may not want his protection.

episodes.title: Fight or Flight
episodes.summary: Frank and Amy end up in a motel room together, but the people after Amy get information on Frank from Beth and come after him. Meanwhile, Dinah pays Billy another visit in the hospital.

episodes.title: Trouble the Water
episodes.summary: Pilgrim and his men launch an attack on the station to get Frank, and Frank tries to convince Sheriff Hardin to let him help.

episodes.title: Scar Tissue
episodes.summary: Frank and Billy both visit some old associates, while Amy remembers some of the circumstances that put her on the run from Pilgrim.

episodes.title: One-Eyed Jacks
episodes.summary: Frank sets out to find out more about Konchevsky, and uses Turk Barrett as bait. Billy makes a new friend, and Krista goes to the window.

episodes.title: Nakazat
episodes.summary: Once Frank and Amy develop the photos, Frank goes after Poloznev. Billy goes after Curtis, and Mahoney goes after Dinay.

episodes.title: One Bad Day
episodes.summary: Frank and Curtis close in on Billy, who is preparing for his first robbery.

episodes.title: My Brother's Keeper
episodes.summary: Billy starts to remember the past after his encounter with Frank, and then makes an offer to the Boys. Curtis meets Amy for supper, and Frank pays a visit to his wife's grave.

episodes.title: Flustercluck
episodes.summary: Following Anderson's orders, Pilgrim puts a bounty on Frank and Amy's head. Amy turns to a friend for help, while Frank continues looking for Billy... who is paying a visit to Dinah.

episodes.title: The Dark Hearts of Men
episodes.summary: Frank goes after Billy, and Curtis and Pilgrim both end up with blood on their hands. Krista and Dinah talk about hells, and Krista realizes how Billy can break Frank.

episodes.title: The Abyss
episodes.summary: While Frank lies in custody, Dinah teams up with Karen Page to find out what really happened at the warehouse.

episodes.title: Collision Course
episodes.summary: Mahoney takes Frank for a ride, Pilgrim pays Curtis and Amy a visit, and Krista takes a fall for Billy.

episodes.title: The Whirlwind
episodes.summary: When Pilgrim abducts Amy and demands David's return, Pilgrim and Frank meet in final combat.
